summary: Iteration 70 - Phone Login & Kiosk PIN/Phone-Last-4 Check-in Testing Complete. Backend: 15/15 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working.
seed_data_creation: None - tests create and cleanup TEST_ prefixed data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phone login and kiosk PIN/phone-last-4 check-in features fully tested: (1) Login with phone normalization works - +256700... and 0700... formats both accepted via phone_variants array. (2) Login with email continues to work. (3) Kiosk /api/kiosk/pin-checkin with action=lookup returns member info without creating checkin. (4) PIN match is tried first, then phone-last-4 regex fallback. (5) Phone-last-4 search checks members, users, and guests collections. (6) action=checkin creates checkin record. (7) Frontend KioskPage shows updated text 'Enter PIN, last 4 digits of phone, ID number, or email'. (8) Frontend handleIdLookup correctly tries pin-checkin endpoint for 4-6 digit numeric inputs. (9) All major pages (Dashboard, Members, Events, Financial) load correctly.

login_phone_normalization.notes: Phone variants array handles +256700.../0700.../700... formats. Uses $in query for flexible matching.

login_email.notes: Email login continues to work as expected

kiosk_pin_checkin_lookup.notes: Returns member_name, member_id, role, type without creating checkin record

kiosk_pin_match_first.notes: PIN match is tried first via db.members.find_one({pin: pin})

kiosk_phone_last4_fallback.notes: Phone-last-4 regex match ($regex: pin$) used as fallback when PIN not found

kiosk_search_all_collections.notes: Searches members, users (active status), and guests collections for phone-last-4 match

kiosk_checkin_action.notes: Creates checkin record with method='pin', source='kiosk'

kiosk_ui_text_update.notes: CardDescription shows 'Enter PIN, last 4 digits of phone, ID number, or email'. Input placeholder shows 'PIN, last 4 of phone, or email'

kiosk_handleIdLookup.notes: Detects 4-6 digit numeric input via /^\d{4,6}$/ regex and tries pin-checkin endpoint first before regular lookup

major_pages.notes: All major pages load correctly without errors
